test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active voice of the given sentence.**

Every living being’s right to housing must be respected.

options.text: You must have respected every living being’s right to housing.
Every living being’s right to housing must have been respected by you.
You must respect every living being’s right to housing.
You have to be respecting every living being’s right to housing.

solution:
The correct answer is: **You must respect every living being’s right to housing.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice and in the **imperative **form of the Present tense.
 
• The active voice has the following form: Subject + modal + V1+ object__
 
• The passive voice has the following form: __**Object+ modal + be + V3 + subject**__
 
• Rules of Conversion from Passive to Active Voice:
 __
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the Subject into the object.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct Active Voice:__ *You must respect every living being’s right to housing.*
